verdict.rationale: Otter documents its own Public API, webhooks, and an MCP server, but the evidence frames them around reading meeting data out (transcripts, action items, search) rather than matching the UI's full feature set. Nothing shows parity, and recording, scheduling the notetaker, editing notes, channels, admin and AI Chat are not shown as API-accessible. Missing for 10: API reference or endpoint coverage showing UI-equivalent operations (recording, uploads, scheduling, editing, sharing, admin), any statement of API/UI parity, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API depth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Custom Integrations with Otter's Public API: Otter meeting data connects to any system, including niche CRMs and proprietary platforms, unlocking advanced AI meeting agent workflows.
Teams can automatically ingest meeting transcripts into internal knowledge bases or trigger actions based on meeting content
Otter's MCP Server connects your meeting data directly to AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT, bringing your meeting intelligence into your everyday AI workflows.
